# Taquería Chapala Jalisco

> Taqueria in San Antonio, Texas. Breakfast tacos on fresh tortillas, steak plates and soups, in a room of painted murals.

- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Breakfast tacos; Carne asada and fajitas; Plates and enchiladas
